target.question: Why does Kira keep preferring the longer harbor route?
candidates: Kira prioritizes avoiding an uncertain bridge.
Kira is optimizing arrival time after considering traffic.
Kira is trying to reduce fuel use.

initial_events.raw_text: Kira chose the harbor route twice despite a slightly longer trip.
A bridge inspection notice reached the dispatcher but delivery to Kira is not recorded.
A different driver discussed a cafe opening near the depot.
The dispatcher later learned the bridge inspection was postponed; no message to Kira is recorded.

probes: Ask Kira whether the bridge uncertainty matters to the choice.
Ask Kira what arrival deadline she is optimizing for.
Ask Kira whether fuel use is the limiting factor.

SAFETY.ASK_BRIDGE: Kira says she has not received an official all-clear and would rather avoid the bridge.
SAFETY.ASK_FUEL: Kira says fuel is not the deciding concern.

ARRIVAL.ASK_BRIDGE: Kira says the bridge is fine and the harbor route is faster at her departure time.
ARRIVAL.ASK_ARRIVAL: Kira says she is optimizing a fixed arrival window.

FUEL.ASK_BRIDGE: Kira says the bridge is not the issue.
FUEL.ASK_FUEL: Kira says the harbor route uses less fuel for her vehicle.

actions: Keep the harbor route until Kira receives and assesses the bridge update.
Plan departure around the faster arrival window.
Compare route fuel use before changing the route.

target.question: Why has Mina not approved the exhibit caption?
candidates: Mina needs a reliable provenance citation.
Mina agrees but has not had review time.

initial_events.raw_text: Mina marked the caption pending and circled its source attribution.
The archive sent a corrected source card to the assistant, with no recorded delivery to Mina.
Facilities replaced a lamp in a different gallery.
Mina continued to use the pending label after the assistant updated a draft copy.

probes: Show Mina the corrected source card and ask whether it resolves her concern.
Ask Mina whether she disagrees with the caption interpretation.

SOURCE.SHOW_SOURCE: Mina says the corrected citation resolves the provenance issue.
SOURCE.ASK_INTERPRETATION: Mina says the interpretation is acceptable if the citation is verified.
SOURCE.OFFER_TIME: Mina says time is available but the source needs checking.

DISAGREES.SHOW_SOURCE: Mina says the citation is fine but the interpretation remains wrong.
DISAGREES.ASK_INTERPRETATION: Mina explains a specific interpretive disagreement.
DISAGREES.OFFER_TIME: Mina says more time will not settle the disagreement.

WORKLOAD.SHOW_SOURCE: Mina says the source is fine and she simply has not completed her review.
WORKLOAD.ASK_INTERPRETATION: Mina says she has no interpretation concern.
WORKLOAD.OFFER_TIME: Mina accepts a review slot and can sign off.

actions: Verify the citation with Mina before approval.
Schedule review time without changing the caption.

target.question: Why did Noor stop confirming the community shift?
candidates: Noor lacks a reliable way to reach the site.
Noor has a conflicting caregiving duty.
Noor no longer wants this shift.

initial_events.raw_text: Noor had previously confirmed three shifts but did not confirm the next one.
A route suspension notice reached the organizer; receipt by Noor is unknown.
Another volunteer changed a supply order.
Noor replied that the time itself still works, but did not explain the silence.

probes: Ask whether a reliable ride would make the shift possible.
Ask whether a caregiving obligation conflicts with the shift.
Ask whether Noor still wants to volunteer.

TRANSPORT.OFFER_RIDE: Noor says yes; the bus route was cancelled and a ride would solve it.
TRANSPORT.ASK_CARE: Noor says caregiving is not a problem.
TRANSPORT.ASK_INTEREST: Noor says yes, if travel is possible.

CARE.OFFER_RIDE: Noor says transport is fine but the caregiving duty remains.
CARE.ASK_CARE: Noor says a caregiving duty prevents the shift.
CARE.ASK_INTEREST: Noor says yes but cannot make this time.

INTEREST.OFFER_RIDE: Noor says a ride would not change their decision.
INTEREST.ASK_INTEREST: Noor says they would rather step away from shifts.

actions: Arrange a ride only with Noor consent.
Find a replacement for the caregiving conflict.
Release Noor from the shift without pressure.

target.question: Why does Jules avoid the shared recording room?
candidates: Jules needs a quieter room to work.
Jules needs a private conversation space.
Jules needs equipment absent from that room.

initial_events.raw_text: Jules declined the shared recording room and asked for an alternative.
The coordinator received notice that acoustic panels were installed; Jules did not receive the notice.
A separate team reordered desk chairs.
Jules accepted a time slot but still requested another room.

probes: Offer a private room with the same equipment and ask if that works.
Explain the acoustic change and ask if the room now works.
Ask which recording equipment Jules needs.

NOISE.OFFER_PRIVATE: Jules says privacy is not important; quiet is the issue.
NOISE.OFFER_QUIET: Jules says the acoustic change would make the room usable.
NOISE.ASK_EQUIPMENT: Jules says existing equipment is enough.

PRIVACY.OFFER_PRIVATE: Jules says yes; the conversation needs privacy.
PRIVACY.OFFER_QUIET: Jules says quieter sound does not solve the privacy concern.

EQUIPMENT.OFFER_PRIVATE: Jules says privacy is fine but needs a different microphone.
EQUIPMENT.OFFER_QUIET: Jules says noise is not the issue.

actions: Use the room after Jules checks the acoustic change.
Provide the needed microphone before booking.

target.question: Why does Anika keep handing out written notes after a live explanation?
candidates: Anika is making the material accessible to absent participants.
Anika needs a durable audit record.
Anika is following a routine without a specific need.

initial_events.raw_text: Anika handed out written notes after two workshop explanations.
The organizer learned that two participants missed the second meeting; delivery of that news to Anika is unconfirmed.
A different workshop changed its projector settings.
Anika asked whether the notes should include diagrams but did not explain why.

probes: Ask Anika whether the notes are intended for participants who missed the session.
Ask whether the notes are needed for a formal record.
Ask whether the notes are simply a standard routine.

ACCESS.ASK_ABSENT: Anika says yes, absent participants need the notes and diagrams.
ACCESS.ASK_AUDIT: Anika says no formal audit is required.
ACCESS.ASK_ROUTINE: Anika says the notes help people who missed the session.

AUDIT.ASK_ABSENT: Anika says the missing participants are not the reason.
AUDIT.ASK_AUDIT: Anika says the program requires an auditable written record.
AUDIT.ASK_ROUTINE: Anika says it is a compliance step.

HABIT.ASK_ABSENT: Anika says she did not know anyone missed the session.
HABIT.ASK_AUDIT: Anika says there is no audit requirement.
HABIT.ASK_ROUTINE: Anika says she has always handed out notes this way.

actions: Make the notes and diagrams available to absent participants.
Store the notes as the required record.
Check whether the routine helps before continuing it.

target.question: Why has Chen paused review of the library update?
candidates: Chen expects an API compatibility break.
Chen has not had enough review time.

initial_events.raw_text: Chen marked the update as awaiting review after reading the change summary.
The author fixed a security scanner warning and informed the maintainer; Chen was not notified.
A different repository announced a documentation release.
Chen asked which older clients still use the removed method.

probes: Show Chen the older-client compatibility inventory and ask if it resolves the pause.
Ask Chen whether the scanner warning is the blocker.

SECURITY.CHECK_OLD_CLIENTS: Chen says compatibility is acceptable but the security finding remains.
SECURITY.CHECK_SECURITY: Chen says the security risk needs a verified fix.
SECURITY.OFFER_REVIEW: Chen says time is not the issue.

COMPAT.CHECK_OLD_CLIENTS: Chen points to an older client still using the removed method.
COMPAT.CHECK_SECURITY: Chen says security is not the remaining concern.
COMPAT.OFFER_REVIEW: Chen says more time will not fix the compatibility break.

CAPACITY.CHECK_OLD_CLIENTS: Chen says compatibility looks fine but has not finished reviewing.
CAPACITY.CHECK_SECURITY: Chen says the security issue is resolved.
CAPACITY.OFFER_REVIEW: Chen accepts a review block and expects to finish.

actions: Verify the security fix with Chen.
Restore or migrate the older-client API before approval.
Reserve review time without changing behavior.
